sentence: This project builds a reference set of human protein-coding transcripts that are fully verified by experiments, to make gene annotation more complete and accurate.
This project studies the biochemical pathway that leads to egg activation during fertilization, using molecular and cell biological methods.
This project uses gene editing to find gene regulatory elements that control inflammation-responsive gene expression in stem cell-derived beta cells.
This project provides data science, bioinformatics and biostatistics support and computing resources to researchers at undergraduate institutions in Louisiana.
This project maintains official unique symbols and names for human genes and coordinates gene naming across vertebrate species.
This project studies how cellular metabolism affects the way exosomes are generated and how their molecular contents are determined.
This project tries to find out how host cell proteins called the HUSH complex silence the provirus that HIV becomes in human chromosomes.
This project uses mass spectrometry to build metabolic and lipid maps of Mycobacterium Tuberculosis that link lipids with virulence, drug response and drug resistance.
This project develops methods to discover useful fungal secondary metabolites that have been difficult to characterize.
This project builds spatiotemporal deep learning models that use bedside imaging to help diagnose and predict outcomes in patients with Takotsubo Syndrome.
This project studies how inflammation-induced thermal stress in the tumor microenvironment changes mitochondrial energy use in T cells.
This project provides bioinformatics and statistical expertise to support study design and analysis of cancer research studies.
This project tests whether chronic alcohol use changes the activity of serotonin circuits that control central pain circuits.
This project studies whether exposure to organophosphate flame retardants early in life and chronic stress in adulthood together impair cognitive processing.
This project sets up a cancer screening research recruitment hub and runs real-world clinical trials to advance cancer screening.
This project uses pressure-volume analysis to evaluate left ventricular function in patients with functional mitral regurgitation and predict how they respond to therapy.
This project studies the role of a protein in microglia and macrophage-like cells in driving neurotoxic microglial responses after traumatic brain injury.
This project provides coordination, data standards and management support for a consortium that works to improve nutrition guidance.
This project provides tissue culture services and biobanking of blood and other biofluid specimens to support cancer research.
This project tries to find out which host genetic factors and host-associated microbial community interactions stop bacteria from making a host jump.
